en.headline: Government to review fighting-dog definition after fatal attacks
en.dek: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said the list of controlled breeds and related controls will be examined, with proposals aimed at LegCo within the year.
body: The Secretary for Environment and Ecology, Tse Chin-wan, said on Friday the government would review the statutory definition and list of fighting dogs and examine broader controls on dangerous and large dogs following two recent fatal incidents involving animals.

In a social-media post, Tse said he was deeply saddened by the death of a woman at a Ta Kwu Ling pet facility and by an earlier case in which a large mixed-breed dog killed two smaller pets in Yuen Long. Preliminary assessment indicated the dog involved in the Ta Kwu Ling case carried fighting-dog bloodlines, contrary to an earlier description as a local mongrel. Both cases remain under investigation by the relevant departments.

Under current law, only four specific breeds — the Pit Bull Terrier, Argentine Dogo, Fila Brasileiro and Japanese Tosa — and their crosses are classified as fighting dogs and subject to strict controls. Other large dogs, including the Spanish Mastiff cross involved in the Yuen Long incident, are regulated only as large dogs. Tse said he had instructed colleagues to review the definition and list and to scrutinise the overall control regime so as to strengthen management of dangerous and large dogs.

He added that tighter rules alone would not suffice and that every dog owner bore responsibility for lawful and responsible keeping. The bureau would also explore measures to raise owner awareness and compliance, and would aim to submit proposals to the Legislative Council Panel on Food Safety and Environmental Hygiene within the year.

zh.headline: 謝展寰：檢討格鬥狗隻定義及名單 加強大型狗管理
zh.dek: 環境及生態局長指兩宗近期狗咬事件後將全面審視管控措施，爭取年內向立法會提交建議。
body: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰周五表示，政府將檢討「格鬥狗隻」的定義和名單，並全面審視危險及大型狗隻的管控措施，以回應近日兩宗涉及動物的致命事件。
謝展寰在社交平台發文指，對打鼓嶺一寵物設施女子死亡及早前元朗大型混種犬咬死兩隻小狗的事件深感哀痛。初步判斷打鼓嶺涉事狗隻帶有格鬥犬血統，而非初期所說的唐狗。兩案調查仍在進行，相關部門會嚴肅跟進。
現行法例僅將比特鬥牛㹴、阿根廷杜告狗、巴西非拉狗及日本土佐犬四種特定犬種及其混種列為「格鬥狗隻」並嚴格管制；其他大型狗如元朗案的西班牙藏獒混種則只歸類為「大型狗隻」。謝展寰表示已要求部門檢討定義與名單，並審視整體管控安排，加強管理危險及大型狗隻。
他強調單靠加強管理並不足夠，每位狗主均有責任守法自律。局方會探討提升狗主守法及責任意識的措施，並爭取今年內將建議提交立法會食物安全及環境衞生事務委員會討論。
